title: Active Threats Don't Always Start With Gunfire
summary: Discover how AmberBox Universal Threat Detection identifies gunshots, aggression, glass breaks, and other threats without requiring new hardware.
body_markdown:
Not every threat begins with a gunshot. A confrontation escalates. Glass breaks. An explosion occurs. A disturbance signals that something is wrong. For security teams, the challenge is recognizing these events as they happen, before valuable time is lost. Threat detection needs to recognize more than gunfire.


#### Workplace Violence Has Many Warning Signs


According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics, private industry recorded 78,340 serious cases involving violent acts across 2023 and 2024. These events extend beyond shootings to confrontations, assaults, and other disturbances that can disrupt operations and endanger employees. Security teams are increasingly responsible for understanding a wider range of threats across offices, manufacturing facilities, retail environments, and public spaces. That requires broader situational awareness.


#### One Platform for Multiple Threats


AmberBox Universal Threat Detection expands the intelligence available from existing AmberBox detectors. The platform recognizes: • Gunshots • Aggressive voice • Glass break • Blast • Unusual disturbance By recognizing multiple event types, AmberBox provides security teams with earlier awareness of situations that may require intervention. Detection becomes a source of actionable intelligence, not simply another notification.


#### New Capabilities Without New Hardware


Security technology should become more capable over time. AmberBox delivers Universal Threat Detection through an over-the-air software update to existing detectors, without requiring additional hardware. This allows organizations to expand their threat detection capabilities across installed locations without undertaking another major infrastructure project. AmberBox also provides software updates at no additional cost and a perpetual detector warranty for the life of the subscription. The result is a platform designed to evolve alongside security requirements.


#### Turning Awareness Into Action


The value of threat detection is measured by what happens next. When AmberBox identifies a supported threat event, the system provides actionable information that security teams can use to assess and coordinate their response. For confirmed gunshots, AmberBox automatically initiates its emergency response sequence, including security alerts, E911 notification, and a conference bridge to police dispatch. Together, these capabilities support a more complete approach to workplace safety.


#### Security That Recognizes the Full Picture


#### Threats do not follow a predictable sequence. Security teams need the ability to recognize critical events across the environments they protect and respond with confidence.
